WITH residual AS (
         SELECT audit_event.actor_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AS has_actor_ciphertext,
            POSITION(('@'::text) IN (audit_event.target_id)) > 0 AS has_address_target
           FROM identity.audit_event
          WHERE audit_event.actor_ciphertext IS NOT NULL OR POSITION(('@'::text) IN (audit_event.target_id)) > 0
        ), forward_constraints AS (
         SELECT count(*) AS constraint_count,
            COALESCE(bool_and(NOT pg_constraint.convalidated), false) AS intentionally_not_valid
           FROM pg_constraint
          WHERE pg_constraint.conrelid = 'identity.audit_event'::regclass::oid AND (pg_constraint.conname = ANY (ARRAY['audit_event_actor_ciphertext_null'::name, 'audit_event_target_id_no_email'::name]))
        )
 SELECT 'PRE_0032_NOT_VALID_RESIDUAL'::text AS classification,
    count(*) AS residual_row_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE residual.has_actor_ciphertext) AS actor_ciphertext_row_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE residual.has_address_target) AS address_target_row_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE residual.has_actor_ciphertext AND residual.has_address_target) AS overlapping_row_count,
    forward_constraints.constraint_count,
    forward_constraints.intentionally_not_valid
   FROM residual
     CROSS JOIN forward_constraints
  GROUP BY forward_constraints.constraint_count, forward_constraints.intentionally_not_valid;
